description.value:
Duration constant

A creature affected by NO WORD FOR IT cannot benefit from anything it knew about the effect beforehand. It loses any circumstance bonus, reroll, or automatic-success clause it would gain from having identified, studied, prepared against, or previously experienced the effect, whether it learned of it a moment ago or years before. It still knows your face on sight.

cinderfall.incomplete: Strips metagame/foreknowledge benefits from creatures affected by NO WORD FOR IT -- no rule element denies 'prior knowledge' bonuses generically; confirmed absent, nothing in the roll-option/ or adjust-modifier.ts schemas targets this shape.
